shapeSummary: Round aluminum hub, 12 mm diameter by 4 mm thick, with its axis along Y and its bottom face at Y=0. It has a 3 mm central through bore, four 2.2 mm through holes on a square pattern at ±3.2 mm (bolt circle radius about 4.5 mm), and one radial 2.3 mm set-screw hole on the +Z side at mid-thickness, running from the bore to the outer surface.
warnings: Only the 3 mm shaft diameter comes from the listing. The 12 mm outer diameter and 4 mm thickness are estimates scaled from the photos.
The four mounting holes are modeled as plain 2.2 mm through holes at ±3.2 mm. Their size and bolt-circle position are estimated, and the #4-40 threads are not modeled.
The set-screw hole size (2.3 mm) and its position at mid-thickness on the +Z side are assumed. The image analysis suggested 3 mm, but 2.3 mm is closer to a #4-40 tap drill.
The hub axis is placed along Y to satisfy the bottom-at-Y=0 rule, although the image analysis described the axis as Z. The radial hole direction was remapped accordingly.
The set screws and Allen wrench are separate items and are not modeled.
